I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from #central-random itself, a channel Pree is in. Yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) Tobias said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on ticket #8841. He didn't name the customer in that message. But Hollis had just asked about "Tobias's dealer account", and the account page shows Marrow Fieldworks is a dealer network that Tobias has owned since January 5, 2026. So I'm treating #8841 as the Marrow Fieldworks ticket.

I suggested she check with Tobias for the latest status before her call. Other Marrow ticket numbers turned up in the knowledge brain, but I left them out because they came from pages Pree can't see.
